info.description: The Meetings Participants API provides an efficient way to retrieve a list of participants involved in specific meetings. This endpoint enables users to access detailed information about participants, facilitating effective meeting management and collaboration. Ideal for event organizers and administrative personnel, this API supports use cases such as attendance tracking and participant engagement analysis. By leveraging this resource, organizations can enhance their meeting efficiency and follow-up processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of participants for a specific meeting, providing details about their attendance and roles. It is useful for organizers to manage invitees and understand the meeting dynamics.
